sources.snippet: Q: What is the difference between the instruct version and the base model? A: The instruct-tuned version (this model) is optimized for following instructions, chat interactions, and task-specific prompts through supervised fine-tuning. The base Qwen2.5-Coder-3B model has only pretraining and requires more careful prompting.
